# Wiped 1.2.0
- Install verified feature updates directly on your iPhone after computer setup. - Choose a custom app name and import your own app icon. - See confirmation after a successful renewal, with your next expiry date. - Control Live Activity and Siri & Shortcuts from the reorganized Settings. - See service notices in Setup and renewal when support has an update to share. - Improved Apple sign-in compatibility and preserved saved login during updates.
Keep LocalDevVPN connected for on-phone operations. Feature updates do not extend Apple signing expiry; renewal is still required. Trusted-device verification is supported; SMS-only Apple sign-in remains unavailable. A computer reinstall can reset an imported icon.
